scratch_rationale: Built specifically for this benchmark rather than adapted. Fills a genuine gap distinct from the two adapted research-analysis skills: fact-checker verifies whether a stated factual claim is true, and deep-research produces a sourced report — neither questions whether a dataset's own methodology (sampling, measurement, comparison group) is sound enough to support the conclusions being drawn from it. This is a common, distinct failure mode ('the numbers are accurate but the study is still misleading').
live_dependency_note: Text-based methodology-critique task against a described dataset/study — no live external service needed to grade correctly; the described methodology is provided in the prompt itself.
